method: LATEST task b16-ics, 23 Nov 2026 - 36 TI lines. RESULT: 1 line priced; Digi-Key refused on the 2nd read, so the rest is code-finding only. Only prices read in the visible table of a distributor page today are in observations (evidence page-read); search-summary figures are in notes only (SUMMARY-ONLY). Note prefixes: NOT-READ = line worked (orderable code found and / or confirmed on ti.com) but no franchised distributor page with a price could be read; UNPRICED = a distributor page was read and shows no break >= 100; NO-LISTING = pre-production (TI status PREVIEW), no orderable code. DIGI-KEY: 2 requests - the product page for UCC21551CQDWKRQ1 served; the next request, the generic keyword URL keywords=TCAN1473 (which would have been a list page), returned HTTP 403. Under Addendum 4 rule 2 Digi-Key was not read again and no other Digi-Key host was tried. (Earlier runs today - b07, b12 - also got their 403 on a generic-keyword / list URL while exact-code product pages kept serving; whether that is what happened here was NOT tested.) OTHER SOURCES (both tasks together): Master Electronics 4 reads, "no search results" every time (TI UCC21551CQDWKRQ1; Vishay SQJ140EP-T1_GE3, VOMDA1271; Winbond W25Q64JVSSAQ); TME 8 requests = the task limit (1 guessed URL 404, 4 search pages - their visible text shows no product rows, only the product link was taken - and 3 product pages; no 429); one try each, refused: Mouser 503, Arrow 503, Farnell 503, Rutronik 403. Avnet, Newark, Future, RS, Verical were not tried (refused every earlier run today). MAKER PAGES (no price on them - used for code, status and grade only): ti.com 24 requests (16 served: product pages and part-details pages; 8 returned 404 - 6 guessed part-details codes, the BQ79731-Q1 product page, and the part-details URL of LMR604303SRAKRQ1 although Digi-Key lists that code, so a 404 there proves nothing); vishay.com 3 served. TOTAL 45 page requests (+1 cached re-read), 10 web searches (orderable codes only). PACING: sleep 20 before every Digi-Key / Master read; TME reads were spaced about a minute apart except twice, when the wait command was rejected by the shell and the read followed the previous TME request sooner. LINES: 18 priority-1 lines all worked (1 priced, 4 SUMMARY-ONLY, 12 NOT-READ of which 10 now carry an exact orderable code - 7 confirmed on TI part-details pages, 3 seen on Digi-Key listings by search - and 2 (BQ79731-Q1, LMR60440-Q1) still have no confirmed code, 1 NO-LISTING PREVIEW); of the 18 priority-2 lines 2 were worked (AM263P2ASPDFZCZRQ1 UNPRICED at TME, LM74900QRGERQ1 grade confirmed) and 16 were not reached. notResearched lists EVERY open line with the exact code and the URL to read (34 entries: the 18 worked-but-unpriced lines, which are also in parts with what was found, and the 16 not reached); TPS2HCS05-Q1 (NO-LISTING) is only in parts.
